question.problem: What is the expected value of one roll of a seven-sided die?
question.worked_solution:
The expected value of a discrete random variable $X$ with probability mass function $f(x)$ defined over a set $S$ is given by

$$
\text{E}[X]={\sum }_{x\in S}x\cdot f(x).
$$

Let $X$ be the roll of a standard six-sided die. Then the support is $S=\{1,2,3,4,5,6,7\},$ and the corresponding probabilities are all $\frac{1}{7}:$

$$
f(1)=f(2)=…=f(7)=\frac{1}{7}
$$

Summing up the products of each value of $X$ and its associated probability, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & =1\cdot f(1)+2\cdot f(2)+…+7\cdot f(7) \\  & =1(\frac{1}{7})+2(\frac{1}{7})+…+7(\frac{1}{7}) \\  & =\frac{1}{7}+\frac{2}{7}+…+\frac{7}{7} \\  & =\frac{1+2+3+4+5+6+7}{7} \\  & =\frac{28}{7} \\  & =4\,.\end{aligned}
$$
